name: Larsen & Toubro

snapshot.about: Larsen & Toubro is an Indian conglomerate engaged in technology, engineering, construction, manufacturing, and financial services.

narrative: Management promised 15% revenue growth for full year FY26, but missed it as FY26 revenue growth came in at 11.8%. However, order inflow growth exceeded expectations and working capital to revenue improved to 4.1% versus the 10% target.

promises.statement: Company maintains full year FY26 revenue growth guidance at 15%.

said.quote: Accordingly, we maintain our full year revenue growth guidance at 15%

said.quote: With the execution momentum expected to pick up in H2, we are reasonably confident to achieve our full year EBITDA margin target of 8.5%

actual_source.quote: On this reclassified basis, the FY26 margins for Projects, Products and Manufacturing was 7.8%, and we expect the same to be stable as well in FY27 as well

promises.note: Full year FY26 Projects, Products and Manufacturing margin was 7.8% against the 8.5% target.

cash.read: Profits convert strongly into cash. Over FY22 to FY26, cumulative operating cash flow of ₹86,099 crore comfortably exceeded total reported profit of ₹75,124 crore.

bull.point: Order book expanded strongly to ₹7.79 trillion in June 2026, up 27% YoY, providing robust revenue visibility.

evidence.quote: The total order book stood at Rs. 7.79 trillion as of June ‘26, up by 27% as compared to the June 25 level

bull.point: Working capital management showed exceptional improvement, with net working capital to revenue ratio dropping to 4.1% in March 2026.

evidence.quote: As of March 2026, the Net Working Capital to Revenue ratio improved sharply to 4.1%, reflecting an improvement of 690 basis points on a YoY basis

bull.point: Operating cash flows reliably convert profits into cash, with five-year cumulative cash flow from operations reaching ₹86,099 crore against ₹75,124 crore PAT.

evidence.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹86,099 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹75,124 crore.

bear.point: Full-year FY26 revenue growth of 11.8% missed the management guidance of 15%, while P&M segment margin fell short of the 8.5% target.

evidence.quote: Accordingly, we maintain our full year revenue growth guidance at 15%
On the revenue front, growth for FY26 stood at 12% compared to our guidance of 15%
On this reclassified basis, the FY26 margins for Projects, Products and Manufacturing was 7.8%, and we expect the same to be stable as well in FY27 as well

bear.point: New Labour Codes regulation imposed a one-time negative impact of ₹11.9 billion on reported net profit in Q3 FY26.

evidence.quote: The reported PAT for Q3 FY '26 was at Rs 32 billion, down by 4% Y-o-Y, owing to a onetime impact of Rs 11.9 billion arising from the new Labour Codes regulation

bear.point: Auditors highlight revenue recognition across complex long-term construction contracts based on stage of completion as a key audit matter.

evidence.quote: Revenues are recognised under Ind AS 115, “Revenue from Contracts with Customers” basis the nature and type of contracts (i.e., products, projects and services) involved
